package: K35-T1 local edge playback of encoder-produced manifest and segment

result.database: disposable PostgreSQL 17, 84/84 migrations; tmpfs container stopped and removed
result.application: Next.js 16.4.5 Studio multipart upload and media-source APIs; separate scripts/video-worker.ts process and FFmpeg encode
result.edge: actual workers/hls-edge/worker.mjs fetch handler invoked with the playback URL signed by the API and a local R2-binding adapter over encoder-produced objects
playback_assertions: variant playlist URI is read from the master and returns 200 with #EXTM3U
fMP4 segment URI is read from the variant and returns non-empty encoded bytes
result.other_verification: HLS edge worker unit suite 20/20 PASS; repo typecheck, targeted ESLint and git diff check PASS
result.cleanup: test rows and temporary source removed by fixture teardown; Next server and loopback server stopped; object map and temporary PostgreSQL container cleared

limitations: This invokes the actual Worker module locally but does not deploy it to Cloudflare or use a real R2 binding.
No browser playback, decoded-frame/time progression, replace/delete matrix, second user/channel, paid profile or independent review was tested.
K35-T1 is partial; K35-T2/T3 remain open. K01-T3 remains partial pending real provider and rollout acceptance.
